name: FLOOWBOX - LinkedIn Post Scheduler and Repurposer

parameters.text:
=Transform this content into a high-performing LinkedIn post.

Original content:
Title: {{ $json.properties.Name?.title[0]?.plain_text || '' }}
Content: {{ $json.properties['Content']?.rich_text[0]?.plain_text || '' }}
Type: {{ $json.properties['Content Type']?.select?.name || 'insight' }}

LinkedIn post rules:
- Opening line: make it impossible to ignore (no 'I am excited to share')
- Structure: short punchy paragraphs, never more than 2 lines each
- Add white space between paragraphs
- Personal angle: connect to a real experience or observation
- End with a question to drive comments
- Length: 150-300 words optimal
- No hashtag spam — max 3 relevant hashtags at the end
- No corporate buzzwords

Return JSON:
{
  "post_text": "",
  "hashtags": [],
  "best_day": "Tuesday/Wednesday/Thursday",
  "best_time": "7-9 AM / 12-1 PM / 5-6 PM",
  "hook_type": "question/statistic/story/contrarian"
}

parameters.content:
## FLOOWBOX - LinkedIn Post Scheduler
Runs every Sunday evening.
Fetches approved content from Notion.
GPT-4o rewrites each piece in LinkedIn-optimized format.
Schedules via Buffer API.
Updates Notion status to Scheduled.
Posts weekly preview to Slack.
